publicVideo.title: Create a Nostr Account with a Passkey
publicVideo.descriptionSummary: Starts from Get Started, uses the device passkey prompts, covers recovery data, auto-lock and opening the new account.

websiteEvidence.directBrowserResult: Site Unavailable edge page; not treated as live-page evidence.

practicalProblem: Shows how to create a new Nostr identity with a passkey, where provider-backed recovery differs from the encrypted-file fallback, and why a recovery file without an enrolled passkey is insufficient.

channelEligibility.reason: This is the Nostr WoT team's own substantive published tutorial and seven-language guide.

claimsNotMade: No claim that passkey account creation is a new release.
No claim that provider confirmation proves another device can recover.
No claim that a recovery file works without an enrolled passkey.
